title: 第21章 继续深入第22章 三足毒蟾
content_zh:
江若尘不语，回头在人群中扫视了一圈后，走到一人的面前将刀递还给了他：“谢了。”
那人一愣，而后接过刀憨笑：“小兄弟你太客气了，应该是我们谢谢你才对。”
“哈哈，是啊小兄弟，没想到你年纪不大，懂的不少，毒林的妖兽性格你都了解。”
“真是多亏了你小兄弟，不然我们真的危险了。”
……
周围其他人也都跟着轻松一笑，纷纷对江若尘表示起了感谢，眼神中也流露着敬佩之色。
这种感谢敬佩是由衷的，在魔兽森林的生存法则就是崇敬强者，不论出身。
更何况刚才江若尘的决定还救了他们一命。
“大家客气了，既然组成一个团队，自当发挥各自所长，没有什么感谢不感谢的。”
江若尘则是自然的谦虚了一句。
却没想到，这一举动更让周围的那些大汉心里钦佩了，不过大家也没再多说什么，只是眼神中的钦佩情绪更浓郁了一些。
见此状况，一旁的萧战感受到了浓浓的危机感。
“大家先休整吧，接下来还有一段路要走。”
萧战眯着眼睛盯了江若尘一眼，而后又以“团队核心”
的口吻向着其他人说道。
只是没想到，他这话一出口，周围大汉的脸色都是变了。
刚才经历的凶险还历历在目呢，哪里还敢继续深入啊？
“肖少队长，还要深入啊？今天这毒林很是异常，兄弟们都不敢再进了，要不算了吧。”
有一人鼓起勇气，对萧战道。
“是啊肖少队长，我们已经损失了七八位兄弟了，继续深入……凶多吉少啊。”

……
有人带了头，剩余的大汉们也纷纷打起了退堂鼓，都不是很愿意继续深入了。
因为来时他们的队伍，足足有着二十多人，可眼下已经死了三个，重伤了五六个，人员减半不说，还要带着重伤的人，这哪里还敢继续深入冒险？
虽说在魔兽森林生存就是刀口舔血，但谁也不想因为一点灵石冒巨大的风险。
李柔儿听了大家的话，眼神有些难掩的失落，但最终还是下定决心一般：“大家说的有道理，今天的毒林很怪异，既然大家都担心危险，那先离开吧，等改日有机会我再来采是一样的。”
听到李柔儿这话，众人都是松了一口气，准备休整休整原路返回了。
可谁想萧战此时却站出来道：“柔儿姑娘，这怎么能行，我们都前进到这了，怎么能前功尽弃，另外我也答应了李伯伯，一定会帮你取来三足毒蟾的毒蟾酥！”
李柔儿闻言眉头微皱，露出为难之色。
她之所以冒险来此，就是为了捕捉毒林中生活的三足毒蟾提取毒蟾酥，炼制一种二品丹药参加宝药堂的晋升测试。
只要炼制成功，她就将迈入二品炼丹师的序列，如若不成又将等待一年，这样的机会她自然是不愿轻易放弃。
只是考虑到大家的安危，这才下定大决心离去。
content_en:
Jiang Ruochen said nothing, turned around and scanned the crowd, then walked up to a person and handed the knife back to him: "Thank you."
The man was stunned for a moment, then took the knife and smiled naively: "Brother, you are too polite. We should be the ones thanking you."
"Haha, yes, little brother, I didn't expect that you know a lot at your young age. You know the characters of the monsters in the Poison Forest."
"Thanks to your little brother, otherwise we would be in danger."
…
Others around him also smiled easily and expressed their gratitude to Jiang Ruochen, with admiration in their eyes.
This kind of gratitude and admiration is sincere. The rule of survival in the Warcraft Forest is to respect the strong, regardless of origin.
What's more, Jiang Ruochen's decision just now saved their lives.
"Everyone is welcome. Now that we have formed a team, we should give full play to our respective strengths. There is nothing we can't thank you for."
Jiang Ruochen was naturally humble.
Unexpectedly, this move made the big men around him admire him even more, but they didn't say anything more, but the admiration in their eyes became stronger.
Seeing this situation, Xiao Zhan on the side felt a strong sense of crisis.
"Everyone, please rest first, there is still a long way to go."
Xiao Zhan narrowed his eyes and stared at Jiang Ruochen, and then said "core of the team"
said to the others in a tone of voice.
I just didn't expect that as soon as he said these words, the faces of the big men around him changed.
The dangers I experienced just now are still vivid in my mind. How can I dare to go deeper?
"Captain Xiao, do you want to go deeper? The poisonous forest today is very abnormal. Brothers don't dare to go in anymore, so let's forget it."
One person plucked up the courage and said to Xiao Zhan.
"That's right, Captain Xiao. We have already lost seven or eight brothers. If we continue to go deeper... it will be more dangerous than good."
…
Someone took the lead, and the remaining big men also retreated, not very willing to go deeper.
Because when they came, there were more than twenty people in their team, but now three people were dead and five or six people were seriously injured. Not to mention that the number of people was reduced by half, and they also had to take the seriously injured people with them. How could they dare to continue to take risks?
Although survival in the Warcraft Forest is like licking blood from the edge of a knife, no one wants to take huge risks for a little spiritual stone.
After listening to everyone's words, Li Rou'er's eyes were a bit disappointed, but in the end she made up her mind: "What everyone said makes sense. The poisonous forest today is very weird. Since everyone is worried about the danger, let's leave first. It will be the same if I come back to collect some other time when I have the opportunity."
Hearing Li Rouer's words, everyone breathed a sigh of relief and prepared to rest and return the way they came.
But who would have thought that Xiao Zhan stood up at this time and said: "Miss Rou'er, how can this be done? We have all advanced so far, how can we waste all our efforts? In addition, I also promised Uncle Li that I will definitely help you get the poisonous toad cake from the three-legged poisonous toad!"
Li Rouer frowned slightly when she heard this, showing a look of embarrassment.
The reason why she took the risk to come here was to capture the three-legged poisonous toads living in the poisonous forest, extract the poisonous toad nectar, and refine a second-grade elixir to participate in the promotion test of the Treasure Medicine Hall.
As long as the refining is successful, she will enter the rank of a second-grade alchemist. If she fails, she will have to wait for another year. Naturally, she is not willing to give up such an opportunity easily.
It was only out of consideration for everyone's safety that I made up my mind to leave.
